title: Dispatch authorized wire requests
responsibility: Apply connection policy and deadlines, then execute requests with mutation replay tracking.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.context
inputs.description: Attachment and allowed methods, pending-request count, limits, response ledger, handler and error translator, plus optional session epoch binding.

inputs.name: wireDispatch.request
inputs.description: Already validated request with ID, method and input.

outputs.name: wireDispatch
outputs.description: Response with the same ID, a value or null on success, or a declared failure. Mutations join ledger work by ID and input digest; timeouts do not cancel that work.
